reason: I already drive down to Tawfeer or Spinneys once a week and it takes me five minutes. Sending a list the night before, then collecting it, is more hassle than going myself, and I would pay a bag fee for something I can already do.
objection: I only get half of the saving and still pay $1.25 a bag, so after the fee I would barely save anything. I also have to plan my list the night before, and I choose my own fresh produce anyway, so I'd still be going to the shops.
would_change_my_mind: If the saving was clearly big and written on the slip every time, with no bag fee, and I could still change my list on the morning of the run.
